name: Manila Marathon (Galaxy Manila Marathon)
short_description: A full marathon and multi-distance race held June 12, 2026, at SM Mall of Asia Complex in Pasay, Philippines.
ai_summary: The Manila Marathon (Galaxy Manila Marathon) is a full-marathon event scheduled for June 12, 2026, at the SM Mall of Asia Complex in Pasay, Philippines. Runners can choose from four distances: 42.195 km, 21.1 km, 10 km, and 5 km. Registration is currently open, with prices ranging from Php 1,600.00 to Php 3,400.00 depending on the distance selected.

core_facts.venue: SM Mall of Asia Complex, Pasay

pros: Multiple distance options (42.195 km, 21.1 km, 10 km, and 5 km) to suit different runner levels
Centrally located at SM Mall of Asia Complex in Pasay, a well-known venue
Registration is currently open, giving participants time to plan and prepare
cons: Price varies significantly across distances (Php 1,600.00 - Php 3,400.00), so cost depends on which race is chosen

faqs.question: When is the Manila Marathon held?
faqs.answer: The Manila Marathon, also known as the Galaxy Manila Marathon, is scheduled to take place on June 12, 2026. This date applies to the event overall, which includes the full marathon as well as the shorter distance categories offered alongside it.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to register?
faqs.answer: Registration prices for the Manila Marathon range from Php 1,600.00 to Php 3,400.00. The exact cost depends on which distance a participant chooses to run, since the event offers a full marathon, half marathon, 10 km, and 5 km option, each priced differently within that range.

faqs.question: Where is the Manila Marathon located?
faqs.answer: The race takes place at the SM Mall of Asia Complex in Pasay, Philippines. This venue serves as the starting point for all four distance categories offered at the event, making it a central hub for participants and spectators alike on race day.

faqs.question: What distances can I run at this event?
faqs.answer: Participants can choose from four distances at the Manila Marathon: a full marathon of 42.195 km, a half marathon of 21.1 km, a 10 km race, and a 5 km race. This range of options allows runners of varying experience levels to take part.
